problem_statement: The library must provide a disjoint-set (union-find) data structure. A node must be initialisable into its own set via a makeset operation that sets the node's rank and makes it its own root. A find operation must return the root of the set containing the given node, following parent links (and compressing the path along the way). A union operation must merge the sets of two nodes into one, attaching the set with the smaller rank beneath the one with the larger rank so that the higher-rank root becomes the new root (and, when ranks are equal, choosing one root and increasing its rank). After a sequence of unions, find applied to any member of the resulting set must return the single common root of that set.
